target.title: test(qa): redact script evidence diagnostics
target.body:
## What Problem This Solves

QA script producers persist bounded child-process diagnostics as evidence. If stdout or stderr is tailed before redaction, a discarded prefix can remove the context required to recognize a credential while leaving its sensitive suffix in the saved artifact. Configured logging patterns can also span the shared redactor's normal internal chunk boundary.

## Why This Change Was Made

This change keeps one redaction contract instead of introducing producer-specific secret APIs:

- adds an internal full-context variant of the existing tool-payload redactor for callers that have already bounded raw input;
- buffers QA evidence only up to a fixed safe limit, then redacts before taking the persisted tail;
- omits oversized raw logs and failure details rather than truncating before redaction;
- streams hosted-media and ClawHub child output into the evidence writer before their parsing/status buffers discard data;
- retains the existing built-in and configured `logging.redactPatterns` behavior.

The regression crosses both child stream chunks and the shared redactor's 16 KiB boundary with a configured pattern.

## User Impact

There is no product runtime behavior change. QA evidence remains bounded while avoiding secret-bearing tails caused by pre-redaction truncation.

## Evidence

- `node scripts/run-vitest.mjs src/logging/redact.test.ts test/e2e/qa-lab/runtime/script-evidence.test.ts test/e2e/qa-lab/media/hosted-media-provider-live.test.ts test/e2e/qa-lab/plugins/clawhub-release-candidate-install.test.ts` — 140 tests passed across two Vitest shards.
- Blacksmith Testbox through Crabbox `tbx_01kwmw3czcxyb7qj0x5r1gvnn8` — changed type, lint, guard, and import-cycle checks passed; hydration run: https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/actions/runs/28682925039.
- Codex autoreview of the final local patch — clean, no accepted/actionable findings.
- Exact head: `188c2dab6abf9dd084eb04eb99ebef9f56497e89`.
